components.name: Primary action
components.html: <button class="ds-primary">Enter the work <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:20px; background:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); color:var(--deep, oklch(13% 0.006 85)); border:1px solid var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); border-radius:4px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 18px; font:500 13px/1.65 var(--mono, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms,color 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--metal, oklch(82% 0.009 85)); color:var(--deep, oklch(13% 0.006 85)); border-color:var(--metal, oklch(82% 0.009 85)); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

components.css: .ds-choice-row { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-choice { flex:1; min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; background:transparent; color:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); border:1px solid var(--rule, oklch(39% 0.012 85)); border-radius:4px; font:400 12px/1.65 var(--mono, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms,color 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-choice:hover { background:oklch(24% 0.008 85); border-color:var(--metal, oklch(82% 0.009 85)); } .ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); color:var(--deep, oklch(13% 0.006 85)); border-color:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-choice { transition:none; } }

components.name: Contact field
components.description: Native recessed textarea for the optional email draft composer.

components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); font:400 13px/1.65 var(--mono, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-field { width:100%; min-height:95px; padding:11px 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule, oklch(39% 0.012 85)); border-radius:4px; background:var(--deep, oklch(13% 0.006 85)); color:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); font:400 13px/1.65 var(--mono, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); resize:vertical; caret-color:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--muted, oklch(73% 0.015 85)); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Chapter navigation

components.name: Stored risk label

components.css: .ds-risk-result { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; color:var(--muted, oklch(73% 0.015 85)); font:400 12px/1.65 var(--mono, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); margin-top:12px; } .ds-risk { display:inline-flex; min-width:59px; color:var(--low,oklch(82% 0.1 145)); font-size:12px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em; } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-risk-result { gap:8px; font-size:11px; } }

Research notes

components.css: .ds-liquid { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:15px 12px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--metal, oklch(82% 0.009 85)); border-radius:4px; background:linear-gradient(115deg,oklch(28% 0.012 85),oklch(17% 0.008 85) 40%,oklch(35% 0.01 85)); color:var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); font:400 13px/1.65 var(--mono, "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms,color 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-liquid span { flex:1; text-align:left; } .ds-liquid::before { content:""; position:absolute; width:50%; height:200%; left:-60%; top:-50%; background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,oklch(88% 0.01 85 / 0.12),transparent); transform:skew(-25deg); transition:translate 700ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)); } .ds-liquid:hover::before { translate:360% 0; } .ds-liquid:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--bone, oklch(92% 0.016 85)); outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-liquid { transition:none; } .ds-liquid::before { display:none; } }

narrative.overview:
LATENT makes Harsh's language, learning and robotics research tangible inside a continuous spatial world. Warm obsidian, bone, chrome and dark glass connect the scenes. Geometry supplies the imagery; substantial DOM copy and working controls supply the explanation. The owner's pinned world and code-led brief are the visual authority; the earlier portfolios supply no inherited theme.

The experience is dense like a research instrument, with quiet factual prose beside a large physical object. A continuous camera rail connects seven rooms, while a persistent inference console gives visitors chapter navigation, motion and sound controls, and a complete reading alternative. This records the implemented system, refreshing the provisional document that preceded the UI. The direction contract remains in `.impeccable/surface-brief.md`, including the confirmed FORM reference `seed:0165dcf1c61f4b13`; no alternative approved comp is implied.
keyCharacteristics: Warm monochrome materials; colour has a specific research meaning.
Heavy display geometry paired with readable monospaced facts and controls.
One continuous world with real HTML content and native scrolling.
Illustrative interactions explicitly separated from reported research results.
Motion, graphics and sound always have visitor-controlled alternatives.

rules.name: The Colour Means Something Rule
rules.body: Colour is reserved for PRISM's refracted spectrum and LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH labels. Other selection, focus, status and contact feedback use warm neutrals.

rules.name: The Prose Is Not Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Sustained factual qualifications and journey explanation keep the 15px desktop/14px mobile body scale. Compact coordinates, chapter metadata and numerical instruments retain their separate scale.

rules.name: The Geometry Carries Depth Rule
rules.body: Material thickness, light, silhouette and occlusion establish depth. CSS cards, ambient page glows and coloured atmosphere are not substitutes for the owner's physical world.

dos: **Do** use warm neutral CSS tokens and corresponding scene materials; reserve colour for PRISM's spectrum and the three risk labels.
**Do** keep all substantive content and controls in real HTML, with a complete reader and no-WebGL recovery path.
**Do** preserve the 15px desktop/14px mobile sustained-prose scale, native notes scrolling and visible continuation hint.
**Do** keep the seven rooms inside one persistent scene Canvas, with lazy neighbours, bounded visibility, resource cleanup and visitor-controlled motion.
**Do** preserve source qualifications, authentic assets and provenance alongside every reported metric and illustrative control.
donts: **Don't** inherit an earlier portfolio theme, add coloured atmospheric decoration, or replace the continuous world with generic card sections.
**Don't** present stored examples or scripted visualisations as live trained-model inference or browser training.
**Don't** replace readable HTML with mesh text, conceal overflowing notes, or auto-enable sound.
**Don't** generalize one desktop GPU's measured frame rate into a universal 60fps or physical-device compatibility claim.
